observations: body L4, L5: the kasra under the fāʾ of «صَفِيحَةٌ» (L4) stands 2.6 points below the baseline, at the height of the fatḥa over the ṣād of «الصَّلِيبُ» (L5); its x position (under the fāʾ) assigns it to L4.
body L5, L26: the middle digit of «٢٥٣» (L5) and «٢٥٤» (L26) is the closed loop of 5, the first digit a 2 with one crest; the last digit of «٢٥٣» has two crests (a 3).

body L10, L11: the sign above the shadda of «ظِلُّ» (L10) and above the final shadda of «الصَّنَوْبَرِيُّ» (L10, L11) is the flattened damma (a round head with a tail); above the ṣād of «الصَّنَوْبَرِيُّ» and the shīn of «الشَّكْلُ» it is a fatḥa.
body L10: «ٱلأَرْض» has the waṣla on its first alif, the hamza with a fatḥa on the second and a sukūn on the rāʾ; the stroke under the ḍād is the tail of the letter, not a kasra.
body L12, L13, L15: «صنوبريًّا» (L12, L15) has the fatḥatān (two parallel strokes) above the shadda; «الصنوبريّ» (L13) has the shadda alone. «نأخذ» (L12) has no vowel signs.
body L20, L28: «مرّة» (L20) and «عشيّات» (L28) have the shadda alone; «مَثَل» (L20) has fatḥas on the mīm and the thāʾ and no tanwīn.

body L23: «ٱلمِرِّيخ» has the waṣla on its alif, kasras under the mīm and the rāʾ, and no vowel sign on the khāʾ. «Ἀντάρης» is printed with the smooth breathing set before the capital, like an apostrophe.
body L27: «الطِّلْسَمَات» is printed with the shadda and a kasra on the ṭāʾ, a sukūn on the lām and fatḥas on the sīn and the mīm; transcribed as printed.
body L28: the bowl of the d of «ascendens» did not print (only its stem shows); transcribed as the letter.

body L29: «طَوَالعُ» has no kasra under the lām; the stroke below it is the tail of the wāw. A raised speck (1.7 by 1.4 points) is printed before «طَوَالعُ»; not transcribed. The first two digits of «٢٢٣» have one crest each and touch (6.0 points), the last has two crests (4.8 points).
body L32: the first digit of «٣٩» has two crests and touches the 9 (7.4 points together; ٢٩ measures 5.6-5.8).
body L34: the Hebrew «עליות» is printed without points.
notes_right L2: a speck (1.2 by 1.3 points) is printed above the line between «singulare» and «masculinum»; not transcribed.
notes_right L3: «مطالعيّ» has the shadda alone.
notes_right L4: «دَرَجٌ» has fatḥas on the dāl and the rāʾ (the singular, not دُرَج); the sign above the shadda of «مَطْلَعِيَّةٌ» is a fatḥa.
